Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates severe thoracic scoliosis with significant rib cage deformity and right basal opacity (shadowing), consistent with lung compression and atelectasis/consolidation on the convex side or due to restrictive mechanics. Severe scoliosis (Cobb angle ~50°) restricts chest wall compliance and reduces lung volumes, leading to deteriorated respiratory function rather than improvement or equal expansion.
